=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1866-1887 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram message for a report PR that a person must still merge (WLA_REPORT_DELIVERY pr_open, or pr_auto_merge when the report has not landed) is sent with `ALERT_LEVEL="DEBUG"` (line 1887).
  WHY: scripts/tg_helpers.sh sets the default threshold to WARNING (`local threshold="${ALERT_MSG_LEVEL:-WARNING}"`, line 86) and drops messages below it, so a report PR that nobody merges produces no alert; all four reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1604-1680 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `report_last_pushed_sha` starts as "" (line 1604) and is set only after a successful push, which is followed at once by `break` (lines 1679-1680), so every push attempt, retries included, uses an empty `--force-with-lease` value; the comment's claim that "a retry can replace its own earlier push" is never true.
  WHY: Severity is disputed (sonnet NIT; gemini, minimax and gpt MAJOR). Sonnet, gemini and gpt say that if the server accepts a push but the client sees a failure, every retry is rejected as stale, all 5 attempts are used up, the step exits 1 at line 1691 and no PR is opened. Minimax instead says the lease gives no more protection than bare `--force` and could clobber a head someone else wrote.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1772-1800 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The merge-wait loop (default 10 minutes, up to 20) does not account for time already spent in the job's 60-minute budget (`timeout-minutes: 60`, line 835), even though the comment at line 1777 says "the cap keeps the job inside its 60-minute timeout".
  WHY: The analyze step can retry Codex/Claude up to 3 times (about 26.5 minutes per pass), so a slow run is cancelled mid-wait; then committed, report_file and delivery are never written to GITHUB_OUTPUT and downstream watchers record a failure. All four rated this MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1857-1893 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: When the job is cancelled mid-wait, `WLA_COMMIT_OUTCOME` is `cancelled`, not `failure`, so the line-1857 check does not match and the run falls into the "completed" branch at line 1866.
  WHY: The Telegram step reports "Workflow log analysis completed" at DEBUG with a dead blob link to a report that is not on the branch. Severity is disputed: minimax rated it NIT as a separate finding; sonnet raised it inside its MAJOR merge-wait finding.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1857-1865 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The delivery-failed message (line 1862) always says the report "may be on branch auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}".
  WHY: That branch does not exist in push mode (WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR=false/0/no/off) or for failures before any push (regex refusal at line 1489, ref-type check at line 1505, empty target branch at line 1510), so the operator is sent to a branch that does not exist. All four rated this NIT.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1630-1631 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `grep -vxF` exclusion `refs/remotes/wla-pending/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-}` is claimed not to match the local refs that the fetch refspec creates, so the run's own branch would not be excluded from the collision check.
  WHY: Severity is disputed (gemini NIT, minimax MAJOR: the run would rename its own report to `-2.md` after a partial push). Sonnet explicitly disputes the finding: the refspec maps `*` to `<run_id>-<attempt>`, so the literal is the correct local name.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1614-1645 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The run branch is deleted only when this run sees the report land (lines 1767-1769, 1800-1803), so branches from unlanded, later-merged or closed report PRs build up, and every later run lists and shallow-fetches all of them on each push attempt.
  WHY: The fetch cost grows without limit, and leftover branches keep their dated report paths counted as taken, which forces unnecessary same-day suffixes. All four rated this NIT.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1783 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_MERGE_POLL_SECS` is read with `${WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_MERGE_POLL_SECS:-30}` but is never exported in the step's `env:` block (lines 1464-1479), so the poll interval is always 30.
  WHY: A repo variable an operator sets has no effect, even though the agents.d fragment documents it as configurable. Gemini raised the same issue only as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=5

The workflow is 157,529 bytes and the PR diff has no hunk in tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py; the autofix summary blames a missing PyYAML in the sandbox. === FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1866-1887 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The only Telegram message for a report PR that a person must merge (pr_open at line 1806, or pr_auto_merge not landed by the end of the wait at line 1809) is sent with `ALERT_LEVEL="DEBUG"` (line 1887).
  WHY: scripts/tg_helpers.sh line 86 `local threshold="${ALERT_MSG_LEVEL:-WARNING}"` drops the message, so an unmerged report PR produces no alert; the only trace is a `::warning::` annotation. Fix: set ALERT_LEVEL="WARNING" for pr_open/pr_auto_merge.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1604, 1671-1680 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `report_last_pushed_sha` is set only after a successful push followed by `break`, so every retry pushes with an empty lease ("the branch must not exist yet"); the comment's claim that "a retry can replace its own earlier push" is never true.
  WHY: If a push lands but the client sees a failure, every retry is rejected as stale, the loop uses all 5 attempts and exits 1 at line 1691 without a PR. Fix: lease against `git ls-remote` before each retry, or correct the comment.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1772-1799 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The merge wait ignores how much of the 60-minute job timeout (line 835) is left, and the analyze retry loop (lines 1363-1383) has no step-level deadline; when the job is cancelled mid-wait, `cancelled` does not match the line-1857 `failure` check and the run falls into the "completed" branch at line 1866.
  WHY: No outputs are written, Telegram reports "completed" at DEBUG with a dead blob link, and the watchers record a failure. Fix: clamp wla_wait_deadline to the remaining budget and treat cancelled like failure.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1862 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The delivery-failed message names the PR run branch for every commit_report failure, including push mode and failures before any push (lines 1489, 1505, 1510).
  WHY: The operator is sent to a branch that does not exist; in push mode the report commit is lost when the job ends after line 1691, and the message does not say so.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1620-1631 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The run branch is deleted only at lines 1767 and 1800-1803, so branches from auto-merge after the wait, from manual merges of pr_open PRs and from closed PRs build up and are listed and shallow-fetched on every push attempt.
  WHY: The fetch grows without limit, and closed-PR branches keep their dated paths counted as taken, which forces renames.
- NAMING / BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY: NONE (checked: step name, `id: commit_report`, `if:`, outputs unchanged at lines 1461-1463 and 1577-1578; the job-level `permissions:` at lines 841-846 is safe because the workflow is workflow_dispatch-only).
- IMPLICIT-EXECUTION & TRUST-BOUNDARY: NONE (checked: report file is regex-validated, PR body is linted, REPORT_PR_BRANCH is regex-checked; the pass-1 claim that the `wla-pending` exclusion literal is wrong is incorrect: `refs/remotes/wla-pending/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}` is the correct local name).
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE (explicitly not gaps: the test_log_analysis_purge... asserts still match and the failure is inherited; the size guard is a missing-PyYAML environment problem at 157,529 bytes; the plan P1 file is absent and was earlier recorded as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED).
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: match `failure|cancelled` at line 1857 and use WARNING for pr_open/pr_auto_merge; clamp wla_wait_deadline (line 1787) to start + 55*60; set the lease from `git ls-remote` on retries (lines 1677-1679); print the "may be on branch" sentence only in PR mode (line 1862). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3 (4 related items)
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: After a push the server accepted but the client saw as failed, a retry cannot lease against the server-side tip; a lease of an empty string against an existing ref is rejected, so the comment's claim is false.
